claim_one_line: THE CASCADE RECOVERY -- eleven banked arcs the synthesis layer had forgotten. Prompted by the OWNER, who reported that work around B862 felt like the SM was almost clarified and that something was lost afterwards. THEY WERE RIGHT, AND IT IS A COUNT, NOT AN IMPRESSION. THE MEASUREMENT: every arc banked in B800-B880 (60 of them) checked against the five current synthesis surfaces -- 39 are cited on NO surface, and of the twelve cascade-closure arcs B860-B873, only ONE is cited anywhere. Many of the 39 are legitimately process arcs (the verdict campaign, the atlas lexicon, the harvests) and an object-atlas is right to omit them; THE CASCADE BLOCK IS NOT. B860, B861, B863, B864, B865, B868, B869, B870, B871, B872 and B873 appear ZERO times in LAW_MAP and zero times in the SM verdict; only B862 appears, and only because the solo seat caught it an hour earlier. TWO OF TODAY'S CLAIMS WERE CONTRADICTED BY BANKED WORK. (i) The global Z6 form: I wrote 'not addressed'; B862 DERIVES [SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)]/Z6 and calls it the first place the selected structure OUTPERFORMS the SM's own. Caught by the solo seat; corrected. (ii) HYPERCHARGE, and this one is worse: I wrote 'no derivation from anomaly cancellation inside the object -- OPEN, the sharpest available target', but B864, banked 2026-08-03, establishes that HYPERCHARGE IS THE UNIQUE GAUGEABLE U(1) IN THE CHAIN'S ABELIAN SECTOR -- over the chiral generation Q = aY + b*chi + c*psi gives grav = 5b+15c, [SU(3)]^2 = 2c, [SU(2)]^2 = 2c, FORCING b = c = 0 exactly, while psi and chi are anomalous (Tr psi = 16, Tr chi = 5) and therefore ungaugeable, so the cascade's strip-the-dials rule is a CONSEQUENCE of anomaly consistency rather than a definition. On the strength of my wrong row I REGISTERED L132 to find what had already been derived, COMMISSIONED a literature panel (B951) to scout it, and PUT IT INTO MASTERPLAN v3 PHASE A, WHICH IS RUNNING NOW. What genuinely remained is far narrower: the NORMALISATION (not derivable, since anomaly conditions are homogeneous -- B951) and whether the SMT's u(1)^3 IS the (Y, chi, psi) triple, which B953 INFERRED rather than computed and flagged as such. WHAT WAS NOT LOST, AND THIS MATTERS: the repository lost NOTHING -- every one of those arcs is banked, locked and passing, and the mathematics is intact and reproducible today. WHAT WAS LOST IS THE SYNTHESIS LAYER'S AWARENESS OF THEM: LAW_MAP, the ledgers and the verdict are compressions, and the compressions dropped eleven arcs entirely. THIS IS B965'S FINDING AT SCALE -- B965 found qualifiers lost when an arc verdict is compressed into a LAW_MAP row ('the arcs are honest; the summaries leak'), and this is the same leak one level up: WHOLE ARCS NEVER COMPRESSED INTO A ROW AT ALL. Same layer, larger instance, and it went undetected because NOTHING CHECKS THAT A SUBSTANTIVE BANKED ARC IS REPRESENTED ANYWHERE -- both gates built today police the CONTENT of rows that exist, and neither notices a row that was never written. ON CAUSATION: I CANNOT say the model switch caused this, having no access to the chat history, and correlation is not causation -- I decline to claim it; I CAN say the loss is REAL, is LOCALISED to a range the owner identified independently before I measured anything, and is a COUNT, and that whatever the cause the remedy is identical and mechanisable. REGISTERED L143, THE REPRESENTATION SWEEP: nothing checks whether a substantive banked arc appears on any synthesis surface, and this audit's query IS the check -- for every arc with a non-instrument verdict and a FINDINGS above the size floor, is its ID cited in LAW_MAP or a ledger? Unrepresented arcs are either genuinely process (fine, triage them as BLIND_ARCS already does) or forgotten (not fine). Build it as a gate: it is the missing third member of the pair built today. CORRECTIONS APPLIED: the spec ledger's hypercharge row rewritten to DERIVED (direction) with the normalisation limit stated and section D2 rewritten noting the original row was wrong and why; and THE_SM_VERDICT amended with a banner, four added rows (Z6 derived, hypercharge derived, the termination theorem, P5/padding/anomaly-ledger/G4-G7), a corrected L132 entry, and L138's stale 'unworked' refreshed to FIRED.
